Britto

Open any product on Amazon.in, Flipkart or Myntra. Britto shows its price history and whether the discount is real, in a panel at the bottom right.

What Britto sends

Only what the product page shows: its address, title, image, price, M.R.P. and whether it is in stock, plus which version of Britto's reader read it. When a page cannot be read, only the store's name and that it failed. Never your cookies, account, orders, address or browsing history. Prices you see help every Britto user; a big jump is shown only after a second shopper sees the same.

Spend Lens

Open your orders page on a store Britto has learned to read, and Britto adds up what you spent. The orders stay on this computer.
